name: Visitor entry (visa-free or visa)
summary: Many nationalities enter visa-free for 30 days to 6 months depending on country (US is 6 months, UK and Commonwealth listed as no visa). Others need a visa, and a few can get one at the port of entry.

other: Some countries need a US, Canada, UK or Schengen visa plus vaccine proof
Haitian ordinary passport holders transiting Jamaica need a visa from 12 October 2026
Table last updated July 2023, check PICA before travel
Passport and C5 immigration form required

name: Extension of stay
summary: Extend your stay before it runs out. Visitors can get up to 12 months (Commonwealth) or 6 months (others). Student, work, marriage and dependent categories exist.

other: Passport valid 6 months beyond stay
Work needs a work permit or exemption from the Ministry of Labour
Marriage exemption: Jamaican spouse attends with the applicant
Fees on PICA fees page, not confirmed

name: Work Permit
summary: The Ministry of Labour and Social Security Work Permit Section runs work permits under the Foreign Nationals and Commonwealth Citizens (Employment) Act and the CARICOM Free Movement of Skilled Persons Act. Fees and rules were not readable online.

other: Conditions, fees and processing time not confirmed on a readable official page.

sources.label: Ministry of Labour and Social Security: Work Permit

name: Permanent Residence
summary: Live and work in Jamaica with no limit on stay and no work permit needed. Categories: employment (more than 3 years working in Jamaica), retirement, marriage to a Jamaican, dependent of a permanent resident, and former unconditional landing holders. Applicants are interviewed and processing is usually 3 to 6 months.

other: Employment route is for people who have worked in Jamaica more than 3 years
Proof of financial means, police certificate, medical certificate, two Jamaican references, original documents only
Permanent residents do not get the same constitutional rights as citizens
Fee amount not read on this page

documents: Proof of financial status and means of support
Two passport photos certified by a Justice of the Peace
Letter stating reason for permanent residence
Two reference letters from Jamaican nationals

name: Citizenship by Naturalisation
summary: Be 18 or older, of good character, and have lived in Jamaica at least 5 years in total, including the 12 months right before you apply. Four Jamaican-born references and a newspaper notice are required. Compliant applications go to the Minister within 24 months.

other: 5 years aggregate residence plus the last 12 months continuous
Four references who are Jamaican by birth, not civil servants, relatives or lawyers
Notice of intent published twice in a daily paper at least a week apart
Tax compliance certificate, income proof and bank statement

processing: Compliant applications are prepared for the Minister within 24 months.

citizenship.note: Jamaica accepts dual nationals. Check your home country allows it.

name: Citizenship by Descent
summary: For people born outside Jamaica to a parent who is a Jamaican citizen by birth, descent or marriage registration (one generation, with rules for births before 6 Aug 1962). Apply with PICA or a Jamaican mission abroad.

other: Born abroad after 5 Aug 1962 to a Jamaican parent who was a citizen by birth, descent or registration through marriage
Or born abroad before 6 Aug 1962 to a parent who became a citizen on that date
Fee waived if you previously held a Jamaican passport

processing: Regular 90 working days, expedited 45 working days. The page also quotes 25 and 15 working days elsewhere, so check PICA.

name: Citizenship by Marriage
summary: A non-national married to a Jamaican citizen can apply for registration with Form R1. Compliant applications go to the Minister within 24 months. A minimum marriage length was not stated on the page.

other: Married to a Jamaican citizen
Police certificate from last country of residence before Jamaica

processing: Prepared for the Minister within 24 months.
